description: Centri Operativi di Protezione Civile is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportale.regione.lazio.it. COC (Communal Operational Centre), COI (Intermunicipal Operation Center), COM (Mixed Operation Center) reported in the Municipal Emergency Plans of the Municipal Municipalities of the Lazio Region. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Civil Protection Operations Centres" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Italy. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
